description:
EnvNode ESP32 core circuit including ESP32 DevKitC and non-volatile
board identification using a 24AA025E48 I2C EEPROM with factory-programmed
EUI-48 identifier.

The board identification EEPROM is connected to the EnvNode system I2C bus
on GPIO21 (SDA) and GPIO22 (SCL) and uses I2C address 0x50.

Intended as the common processor and board-identification building block
for ESP32-based EnvNode mainboard variants.
keywords: EnvNode ESP32 DevKitC Core Mainboard Board-ID EEPROM EUI-48 I2C 24AA025E48
